messages:
nina_sdr: hey team :wave: first day here — nina (SDR). I seem to be blocked on a couple of things: HubSpot CRM access says 'account not provisioned', SalesLoft shows SSO error, and I don't have the dialer configured. also would love the latest SDR playbook & objection handling cheat sheet. who should I ping?
rob_salesops: welcome nina!! tagging you through. I can provision HubSpot + SalesLoft. quick checklist: 1) confirm company email (is it nina@redwood.ai?) 2) confirm org SSO invite accepted 3) any MFA prompts? 4) preferred phone for Dialpad setup. paste answers here and i’ll start the ticket.
lia_revenue: hey nina — welcome! playbook + scripts here: https://docs.redwood.ai/sales/sdr-playbook (use the internal link). also there’s a short 20min onboarding deck we recorded — watch before your first calls. :point_right: https://videos.redwood.ai/onboarding/sdr-quickstart
onboarding-bot: automated message — new-hire checklist for nina_sdr created. next steps: salesops to provision CRM, cs to enable call recording, it to confirm SSO group membership.
mike_cs: adding — i’ll enable call recording & voicemail setup for your Dialpad once SalesOps gives me the user id. comply note: calls are recorded by default for training unless you opt out in the first week with your manager.
nina_sdr: yes email is nina@redwood.ai. accepted SSO invite. MFA prompt asked for a phone verification but it failed with 'timeout'. i tried re-sending the invite but same.
rob_salesops: thanks — filing IT ticket. Ticket ID IT-5621. description: "SSO provisioning failure for nina@redwood.ai — MFA timeout during initial setup; HubSpot not provisioned; SalesLoft SSO error." IT folks: can you add nina to "sales-sso-users" group and re-initiate Okta push?
it-bot: ticket IT-5621 acknowledged. assigned to @it-ops. ETA 2 business hours. logs: last_okta_push: 1750012300, last_response: 504 Gateway Timeout.
rob_salesops: meantime, temporary access option: we can invite you as a 'limited' HubSpot user (manual) so you can access contact records & sequences (no billing/admin). would you like that?
nina_sdr: yes please that would help me shadow calls & sequences.
lia_revenue: i dropped the latest objection-handling cheatsheet in the sales drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/sales/sdr-cheatsheet.pdf — quick tip: use the 'two-question qualification' flow on page 3. also saved our top 5 email templates in the folder.
mike_cs: rob — when the HubSpot account is ready, confirm the property mapping for 'call_recording_url' -> we use that in Zendesk for handoffs.
rob_salesops: noted. nina, i sent the manual HubSpot invite (limited). check your email (subject: "Redwood HubSpot — invite"). also sent you a temporary SalesLoft session link:  https://app.salesloft.com/temp/4y2k. creds flow is SSO, but this temp session will let you see sequences.
nina_sdr: got the HubSpot invite and SalesLoft temp session works, ty! HubSpot still shows a banner: "Limited access — contact admin" but i can open contacts.
it-bot: update on IT-5621: added nina to group sales-sso-users, re-sent Okta push at 1750012675. please attempt SSO now.
nina_sdr: SSO flow succeeded! no MFA timeout now. i can login via Okta. HubSpot full access confirmed. :tada:
mike_cs: i enabled call recording and set up your Dialpad number + voicemail. you should get an SMS to set your PIN. confirm when you have it.
nina_sdr: got the SMS, voicemail PIN set. dialer logged in and call recording shows on test call. going to run through the playbook now. thanks everyone — super smooth onboarding so far.
rob_salesops: awesome. quick follow-ups for tracking: IT-5621 -> resolved. I'll add you to the SDR weekly shadow rota. lia, can we add nina to tomorrow's morning roleplay?
lia_revenue: done — added to calendar invite. also cc'ing @mike_cs for intro to escalation flows.
mike_cs: intro sent in DM. @nina_sdr if you hit anything about call metadata not appearing in HubSpot tag me.
nina_sdr: will do. one tiny thing — when i open a contact record the 'last_activity' shows yesterday for several leads even though i just dialed them in test. is there a sync delay?
rob_salesops: HubSpot <> Dialpad sync can be up to 5 mins. if it persists beyond 15 mins, ping me and i’ll check webhook logs.
nina_sdr: logged — will monitor. thanks again all! :heart:
